steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Television is one of the most influential media forms, combining visual, audio, and written codes to tell stories and communicate ideas to mass and niche audiences. | Key Fact: Traditional broadcast TV used scheduling to target audiences — primetime (7-10pm) for mass audiences, late night for niche content, daytime for specific demographics. | Key Fact: Streaming services (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+) have disrupted traditional broadcasting — audiences can watch what they want, when they want, on any device. | Key Fact: TV drama conventions: ensemble casts, multiple storylines, cliffhangers, series arcs, episodic and serial structures. Quality TV / 'peak TV' features cinematic production values.
